title: Post-Brexit rights for British citizens are being undermined in Sweden

paragraphs.en: Back in October 2020, the UK immigration minister stood up in parliament to reassure campaigners concerned about EU citizens who weren’t aware they had to ask the Home Office to stay in the country after Brexit.
paragraphs.zh: 早在2020年10月，英国移民事务大臣就曾在议会发言，以安抚那些担心部分欧盟公民的活动人士——这些欧盟公民并不知道自己在脱欧后需要向内政部申请留英居留。

paragraphs.en: Using an example of a child in foster care who might not know they were an EU citizen until they applied for their first job, the Conservative Kevin Foster said the UK would take “a generous approach as to what reasonable grounds [for failing to apply] were”.
paragraphs.zh: 保守党人凯文·福斯特举了一个例子：寄养儿童可能直到申请第一份工作时才知道自己是欧盟公民。他表示，英国将对“何为（未申请的）合理理由”采取宽容态度。

paragraphs.en: In other words, the UK/EU Brexit agreement was designed to protect those who had exercised lawful freedom of movement, and they couldn’t just be chucked out of their host state because the UK had decided to leave the EU.
paragraphs.zh: 换言之，《英国/欧盟脱欧协议》旨在保护那些依法行使自由流动权的人，他们不能仅仅因为英国决定退出欧盟就被赶出所在国。

paragraphs.en: The Home Office is not perfect, and is regularly criticised by campaigners for missteps over the implementation of the EU citizens chapter in the EU-UK withdrawal agreement. But “reasonable grounds” have been outlined in parliament, providing legal arguments to challengers.
paragraphs.zh: 英国内政部并非尽善尽美，经常因在落实《欧盟-英国脱欧协议》中欧盟公民章节方面出现失误而受到活动人士的批评。但“合理理由”已在议会中得到明确阐述，为质疑者提供了法律论据。

paragraphs.en: Yet thousands of miles away in Sweden, post-Brexit rights are being undermined with an apparent high level of removal orders for law-abiding British citizens, some at the most vulnerable stage of their lives.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，在千里之外的瑞典，脱欧后的权利正遭到破坏，大量守法英国公民收到驱逐令，其中一些人正处于人生中最脆弱的阶段。

paragraphs.en: One 74-year-old British man, who has been in Sweden for 25 years, is this week facing deportation despite having vascular dementia and parkinsonism, and being so incapacitated that he is in full-time care.
paragraphs.zh: 一名在瑞典生活了25年的74岁英国男子本周正面临被驱逐出境的命运，尽管他患有血管性失智症和帕金森综合征，且病情严重到需要接受全天候护理。

paragraphs.en: Rejecting a legal request for him to stay using family ties, a Swedish court ruled that immigration interests trumped human rights. “Upon balancing the state’s interest in regulated immigration against what has emerged regarding Horace Mason’s private life and his adaptation to Sweden, the migration court concludes, on balance, that his deportation appears proportionate,” it ruled.
paragraphs.zh: 瑞典一家法院驳回了以家庭纽带为由让他留下的法律请求，裁定移民利益高于人权。法院裁定：“在权衡国家对有序移民的利益与霍勒斯·梅森私人生活及他对瑞典的适应情况之后，移民法院经综合权衡得出结论，对他的驱逐似乎并无不当。”

paragraphs.en: This week, Joyce Thomas , a 78-year-old widow who has been in Sweden for 21 years, also lost her appeal to reverse a migration agency decision that she has to leave the country within four weeks.
paragraphs.zh: 本周，在瑞典生活了21年的78岁寡妇乔伊斯·托马斯也未能通过上诉推翻移民局的裁决，该裁决要求她在四周内离开该国。
